# Libraries, Reading in Data, Parameters

```{r,comment=NA,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(BayesFactor)
library(emmeans)
```

## Colors

```{r,comment=NA}
color_ddm = 'royalblue'
color_logit = 'red'
color_discount_0 = 'white'
color_discount_25 = 'grey'
color_discount_99 = 'grey40'
```

## Data

```{r,comment=NA,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=TRUE}
date_var <- '170923'
date_choice_name <- paste(date_var, '_choice_data', sep="")
date_analysis_name <- paste(date_var, '_matched_data', sep="")
estimates_file_name <- 'estimates'

sess3_2afc_data <- read_csv(file.path(date_analysis_name,'session3_2afc_individual_level_predicted.csv'))
sess3_2afc_pred <- read_csv(file.path(date_analysis_name,'session3_2afc_data_and_estimates_matched_at_individual_level.csv'))
sess3_2afc_estimates <- read_csv(file.path(estimates_file_name,'estimates_63_subjects.csv'))

sess5_2afc_data <- read_csv(file.path(date_choice_name,'session5_2afc_data.csv'))
sess5_2afc_pred <- read_csv(file.path(date_analysis_name,'session5_2afc_market_share_predicted.csv'))

sess4_3afc_pred <- read_csv(file.path(date_analysis_name,'session4_3afc_market_share_predicted.csv'))

share_2afc <- read_csv(file.path(date_analysis_name,'session5_2afc_market_share.csv'))
share_3afc <- read_csv(file.path(date_analysis_name,'session4_3afc_market_share.csv'))

merged_data <- read_csv(file.path(date_analysis_name,'170923_scaled_prediction_merge.csv'))

cannib_3afc <- read_csv(file.path(date_analysis_name,'240414_sess5_3afc_distance_LogitVsDDM_cannibalization_data_all.csv'))
```

# AFC Within-Subjects

```{r,comment=NA,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=TRUE}
date_var <- "X" #insert new date here
plots_dir <- paste0(date_var,"_plots")

if (!dir.exists(plots_dir)) {
  dir.create(plots_dir)
}
setwd(plots_dir)

sess3_2afc_data$discount1_str = as.character(sess3_2afc_data$discount1)
sess3_2afc_data$discount2_str = as.character(sess3_2afc_data$discount2)
sess3_2afc_data$market_string = paste(sess3_2afc_data$brand1,sess3_2afc_data$brand2,sess3_2afc_data$type1, sess3_2afc_data$type2,sess3_2afc_data$discount1_str,sess3_2afc_data$discount2_str, sep = "_")


sess3_2afc_data$ae_ddm = abs(sess3_2afc_data$response - sess3_2afc_data$prob_ddm)
sess3_2afc_data$ae_logit = abs(sess3_2afc_data$response - sess3_2afc_data$prob_logit)
sess3_2afc_data$sae_ddm = abs(sess3_2afc_data$response - sess3_2afc_data$prob_ddm)^2
sess3_2afc_data$sae_logit = abs(sess3_2afc_data$response - sess3_2afc_data$prob_logit)^2


sess3_2afc_subject <- sess3_2afc_data %>% group_by(subject) %>%
                      summarize(mae_ddm = mean(ae_ddm),
                                mae_logit = mean(ae_logit),
                                se_ddm = sd(ae_ddm) / sqrt(n()),
                                se_logit = sd(ae_logit) / sqrt(n()),
                                rmsae_ddm = sqrt(mean(sae_ddm)),
                                rmsae_logit = sqrt(mean(sae_logit)),
                                sse_ddm = sd(ae_ddm) / sqrt(n()),
                                sse_logit = sd(ae_logit) / sqrt(n())
                                )

sess3_2afc_subject <- sess3_2afc_subject %>% left_join(sess3_2afc_estimates, by = "subject")
save_csv_name <- str_c(date_var, "_sess3_2afc_subj_distance_parameters.csv")
write_csv(sess3_2afc_subject,save_csv_name)

p_2afc_subj_rmsae <- ggplot(data = sess3_2afc_subject, mapping = aes(x = rmsae_ddm, y = rmsae_logit)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = rmsae_ddm - sse_ddm, xmax = rmsae_ddm + sse_ddm),
                width = 0) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = rmsae_logit - sse_logit, ymax = rmsae_logit + sse_logit),
                width = 0) +  
  xlim(0.175,0.8) +
  ylim(0.175,0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Error: DDM", y = "Error: Logit", title = "Comparison of Prediction Accuracy by Subject") + 
  theme_minimal() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18)) 
p_2afc_subj_rmsae
save_name_png <- str_c(date_var, "_scatter_plot_subj_rmsae_2afc.png")
ggsave(save_name_png,plot = p_2afc_subj_rmsae,device="png")

t.test(sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_ddm,sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_logit,paired=TRUE)
sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_dif <- sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_logit - sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_ddm
mean(sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_logit)
mean(sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_ddm)
(mean(sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_logit)-mean(sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_ddm))/mean(sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_logit)
bf = ttestBF(x = sess3_2afc_subject$rmsae_dif)
bf
chains = posterior(bf, iterations = 10000)
summary(chains)

sess3_2afc_market <- sess3_2afc_data %>% group_by(market_string) %>%
                      summarize(mae_ddm = mean(ae_ddm),
                                mae_logit = mean(ae_logit),
                                se_ddm = sd(ae_ddm) / sqrt(n()),
                                se_logit = sd(ae_logit) / sqrt(n()),
                                rmsae_ddm = sqrt(mean(sae_ddm)),
                                rmsae_logit = sqrt(mean(sae_logit)),
                                sse_ddm = sd(ae_ddm) / sqrt(n()),
                                sse_logit = sd(ae_logit) / sqrt(n())
                                )

p_2afc_market_rmsae <- ggplot(data = sess3_2afc_market, mapping = aes(x = rmsae_ddm, y = rmsae_logit)) + 
  geom_point(color = 'darkgrey') + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = rmsae_ddm - sse_ddm, xmax = rmsae_ddm + sse_ddm),
                width = 0, color = 'darkgrey') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = rmsae_logit - sse_logit, ymax = rmsae_logit + sse_logit),
                width = 0, color = 'darkgrey') +  
  xlim(0.12,0.64) +
  ylim(0.12,0.64) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Error: DDM", y = "Error: Logit", title = "Comparison of Prediction Accuracy by Market") + 
  theme_minimal() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18)) 
p_2afc_market_rmsae
save_name_png <- str_c(date_var, "_scatter_plot_market_rmsae_2afc.png")
ggsave(save_name_png,plot = p_2afc_market_rmsae,device="png")

sess3_2afc_market <- sess3_2afc_market %>%
  mutate(discount_factor = case_when(str_detect(market_string,pattern = "25") ~ "25",
                           str_detect(market_string,pattern = "99") ~ "99",
                           str_detect(market_string,pattern = "_0_0") ~ "00"),
         mae_dif = mae_logit - mae_ddm)

sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_dif <- sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_logit - sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_ddm
t.test(sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_ddm,sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_logit,paired=TRUE)
sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_dif <- sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_logit - sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_ddm
mean(sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_logit)
mean(sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_ddm)
(mean(sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_logit)-mean(sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_ddm))/mean(sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_logit)
bf = ttestBF(x = sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_dif)
bf
chains = posterior(bf, iterations = 10000)
summary(chains)
mod_2afc_market <- lm(rmsae_dif ~ discount_factor, data = sess3_2afc_market)
summary(mod_2afc_market)
emm <- emmeans(mod_2afc_market, ~ discount_factor)
pairs(emm, adjust = "none")

sess3_2afc_market_barplot <- sess3_2afc_market %>% 
  group_by(discount_factor) %>% summarize(mean_rmsae_dif = mean(rmsae_dif),
                                   sd_error = sd(rmsae_dif),
                                   n_error = n(),
                                   SE_error = sd(rmsae_dif) / sqrt(n()))
sess3_2afc_market_barplot

p_2afc_market_barplot <- ggplot(sess3_2afc_market_barplot, aes(discount_factor, mean_rmsae_dif)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = discount_factor, color = discount_factor),show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount"),values=c('black',color_discount_25,color_discount_99)) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount"),values=c(color_discount_0,color_discount_25,color_discount_99)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_rmsae_dif - SE_error, ymax = mean_rmsae_dif + SE_error), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount")) +
  labs(x = "Discount", y = "Error (Logit - DDM)", title = "Error Difference in Within Consumer Predictions") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(text = element_text(size = 16),
                          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
p_2afc_market_barplot
save_name_png <- str_c(date_var, "_barplot_marker_error_2afc.png")
ggsave(save_name_png,plot = p_2afc_market_barplot,device="png")
```

```{r,comment = NA, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE}
attach(sess3_2afc_pred)
```

# 2AFC Across-Subjects

```{r,comment=NA,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=TRUE}
sess5_2afc_pred$discount <- "No Discount"
sess5_2afc_pred[(sess5_2afc_pred$discount1 == 99 | sess5_2afc_pred$discount2 == 99),"discount"] <- "99 Discount"
sess5_2afc_pred[(sess5_2afc_pred$discount1 == 25 | sess5_2afc_pred$discount2 == 25),"discount"] <- "25 Discount"

sess5_2afc_pred <- sess5_2afc_pred %>% rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(prob_max  = ifelse(prob_1_observed > prob_2_observed, prob_1_observed, prob_2_observed),
         prob_predict_ddm = ifelse(prob_1_observed > prob_2_observed, prob_1_ddm, prob_2_ddm),
         prob_predict_logit = ifelse(prob_1_observed > prob_2_observed, prob_1_logit, prob_2_logit))


sess5_2afc_pred_plot <- sess5_2afc_pred %>%
  select(prob_1_observed, prob_1_ddm, prob_1_logit)

sess5_2afc_pred_plot_long <- sess5_2afc_pred_plot %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("prob_1_ddm","prob_1_logit"), 
               names_to = "model", values_to = "prob_predict")

sess5_2afc_error_plot <- sess5_2afc_pred %>%
  select(logit_distance,ddm_distance,discount)

sess5_2afc_error_plot_long <- sess5_2afc_error_plot %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("logit_distance","ddm_distance"), 
               names_to = "model", values_to = "distance")

sess5_2afc_pred$distance_dif <- sess5_2afc_pred$logit_distance - sess5_2afc_pred$ddm_distance
summary(sess5_2afc_pred$distance_dif)
mean(sess5_2afc_pred$distance_dif)
mean(sess5_2afc_pred$logit_distance)
mean(sess5_2afc_pred$ddm_distance)
(mean(sess5_2afc_pred$logit_distance)-mean(sess5_2afc_pred$ddm_distance))/mean(sess5_2afc_pred$logit_distance)
t.test(sess5_2afc_pred$distance_dif)
bf = ttestBF(x = sess5_2afc_pred$distance_dif)
bf
chains = posterior(bf, iterations = 10000)
summary(chains)
```

```{r,comment=NA,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=TRUE}
setwd(plots_dir)

p_forecasting_share_2afc <- ggplot(data = sess5_2afc_pred_plot_long, 
       mapping = aes(x = prob_1_observed, y = prob_predict, color = model)) + 
       geom_point(mapping = aes(shape = model,size = 2)) +
       geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") + 
       scale_shape_manual(labels = c("DDM","Logit"), values=c(16, 5))+
       scale_color_manual(labels = c("DDM","Logit"), values = c(color_ddm, color_logit)) +
       labs(x = "Observed Choice Share", y = "Predicted Choice Share", title = "Forecasting of Binary Choice Shares",
       color = "Model", shape = "Model") +
       guides(size = FALSE) +  
       theme_minimal() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
                               plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
p_forecasting_share_2afc
save_name_png <- str_c(date_var, "_forecasting_share_2afc.png")
ggsave(save_name_png,plot = p_forecasting_share_2afc,device="png")


summary_2afc_error_bar <- sess5_2afc_error_plot_long %>% 
  group_by(model) %>% # the grouping variable
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(distance), # calculates the mean of each group
    sd_error = sd(distance), # calculates the standard deviation of each group
    n_error = n(), # calculates the sample size per group
    SE_error = sd(distance) / sqrt(n())
  ) # calculates the standard error of each group


p_forecasting_error_2afc <- ggplot(summary_2afc_error_bar, aes(model, mean_error)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = model,color=model)) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("DDM","Logit"),values=c(color_ddm, color_logit)) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("DDM","Logit"),values=c(color_ddm, "white")) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_error - SE_error, ymax = mean_error + SE_error), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("DDM","Logit")) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Average Error", color = "Model", fill = "Model", title = "Error in Binary Choice Forecasting") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
                               plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
p_forecasting_error_2afc
save_name_png <- str_c(date_var, "_forecasting_error_2afc.png")
ggsave(save_name_png,plot = p_forecasting_error_2afc,device="png")
```

## 2AFC Revenue

```{r,comment = NA, warninge = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
setwd(plots_dir)

sess5_2afc_pred$price_1 <- 300 - sess5_2afc_pred$discount1
sess5_2afc_pred$price_2 <- 300 - sess5_2afc_pred$discount2

sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_logit_1 <- sess5_2afc_pred$price_1*sess5_2afc_pred$prob_1_logit
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_logit_2 <- sess5_2afc_pred$price_2*sess5_2afc_pred$prob_2_logit
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_logit <- sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_logit_1 + sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_logit_2

sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_ddm_1 <- sess5_2afc_pred$price_1*sess5_2afc_pred$prob_1_ddm
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_ddm_2 <- sess5_2afc_pred$price_2*sess5_2afc_pred$prob_2_ddm
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_ddm <- sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_ddm_1 + sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_ddm_2

sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true_1 <- sess5_2afc_pred$price_1*sess5_2afc_pred$prob_1_observed
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true_2 <- sess5_2afc_pred$price_2*sess5_2afc_pred$prob_2_observed
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true <- sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true_1 + sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true_2

sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_1 <- abs(sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true_1 - sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_logit_1)
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_2 <- abs(sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true_2 - sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_logit_2)
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit <- sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_1 + sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_2

sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_1 <- abs(sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true_1 - sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_ddm_1)
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_2 <- abs(sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true_2 - sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_ddm_2)
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm <- sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_1 + sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_2

sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif <- sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit - sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm
sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_perc <- 100*(sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif/sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_true)

summary_2afc_rev_pred <- sess5_2afc_pred %>% 
  group_by(discount) %>% summarize(mean_rev_perc_dif = mean(revenue_dif_perc),
                                   sd_error = sd(revenue_dif_perc),
                                   n_error = n(),
                                   SE_error = sd(revenue_dif_perc) / sqrt(n()))

summary_2afc_rev_pred$discount <- fct_relevel(summary_2afc_rev_pred$discount,
                                                       "No Discount","25 Discount","99 Discount")

p_forecasting_revenue_2afc <- ggplot(summary_2afc_rev_pred, aes(discount, mean_rev_perc_dif)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = discount, color = discount),show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount"),values=c('black',color_discount_25,color_discount_99)) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount"),values=c(color_discount_0,color_discount_25,color_discount_99)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_rev_perc_dif - SE_error, ymax = mean_rev_perc_dif + SE_error), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount")) +
  labs(x = "Discount", y = "Average Percentage Improvement for DDM", title = "Revenue in Binary Choice") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
                          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
p_forecasting_revenue_2afc
save_name_png <- str_c(date_var, "_forecasting_revenue_2afc.png")
ggsave(save_name_png,plot = p_forecasting_revenue_2afc,device="png")

mean(sess5_2afc_pred$revenue_dif_perc)

summary_2afc_pred_barplot <- sess5_2afc_pred %>% 
  group_by(discount) %>% summarize(mean_distance_dif = mean(distance_dif),
                                   sd_error = sd(distance_dif),
                                   n_error = n(),
                                   SE_error = sd(distance_dif) / sqrt(n()))
summary_2afc_pred_barplot$discount <- fct_relevel(summary_2afc_pred_barplot$discount,

summary_2afc_pred_barplot

p_forecasting_pred_2afc_barplot <- ggplot(summary_2afc_pred_barplot, aes(discount, mean_distance_dif)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = discount, color = discount),show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount"),values=c('black',color_discount_25,color_discount_99)) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount"),values=c(color_discount_0,color_discount_25,color_discount_99)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_distance_dif - SE_error, ymax = mean_distance_dif + SE_error), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount")) +
```

# 3AFC

## 3AFC Across-Subjects

```{r,comment=NA,warning=FALSE,Message=FALSE}
sess4_3afc_pred$discount <- "No Discount"
sess4_3afc_pred[(sess4_3afc_pred$discount1 == 99 | sess4_3afc_pred$discount2 == 99 | sess4_3afc_pred$discount3 == 99),"discount"] <- "99 Discount"
sess4_3afc_pred[(sess4_3afc_pred$discount1 == 25 | sess4_3afc_pred$discount2 == 25 | sess4_3afc_pred$discount3 == 25),"discount"] <- "25 Discount"

sess4_3afc_pred <- sess4_3afc_pred %>% rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(prob_max = max(prob_1_observed,prob_2_observed,prob_3_observed))

sess4_3afc_pred <- sess4_3afc_pred %>%
  mutate(prob_max_ddm = case_when(prob_1_observed == prob_max ~ prob_1_ddm,
                                  prob_2_observed == prob_max ~ prob_2_ddm,
                                  prob_3_observed == prob_max ~ prob_3_ddm),
         prob_max_logit = case_when(prob_1_observed == prob_max ~ prob_1_logit,
                                  prob_2_observed == prob_max ~ prob_2_logit,
                                  prob_3_observed == prob_max ~ prob_3_logit))

sess4_3afc_pred_plot_1 <- sess4_3afc_pred %>%
  select(prob_1_observed, prob_1_ddm, prob_1_logit)

sess4_3afc_pred_plot_1_long <- sess4_3afc_pred_plot_1 %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("prob_1_ddm","prob_1_logit"), 
               names_to = "model", values_to = "prob_predict")

sess4_3afc_error_plot <- sess4_3afc_pred %>%
  select(logit_distance,ddm_distance,discount)

sess4_3afc_error_plot_long <- sess4_3afc_error_plot %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("logit_distance","ddm_distance"), 
               names_to = "model", values_to = "distance")

sess4_3afc_pred$distance_dif <- sess4_3afc_pred$logit_distance - sess4_3afc_pred$ddm_distance
summary(sess4_3afc_pred$distance_dif)
mean(sess4_3afc_pred$logit_distance)
mean(sess4_3afc_pred$ddm_distance)
mean(sess4_3afc_pred$distance_dif)
(mean(sess4_3afc_pred$logit_distance)-mean(sess4_3afc_pred$ddm_distance))/mean(sess4_3afc_pred$logit_distance)

t.test(sess4_3afc_pred$distance_dif)
bf = ttestBF(x = sess4_3afc_pred$distance_dif)
bf
chains = posterior(bf, iterations = 10000)
summary(chains)
```

## 3AFC Revenue

```{r,comment = NA, warninge = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
setwd(plots_dir)

sess4_3afc_pred$price_1 <- 300 - sess4_3afc_pred$discount1
sess4_3afc_pred$price_2 <- 300 - sess4_3afc_pred$discount2
sess4_3afc_pred$price_3 <- 300 - sess4_3afc_pred$discount3

sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_1 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_1*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_1_logit
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_2 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_2*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_2_logit
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_3 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_3*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_3_logit
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit <- sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_1 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_2 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_3

sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_1 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_1*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_1_ddm
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_2 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_2*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_2_ddm
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_3 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_3*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_3_ddm
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm <- sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_1 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_2 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_3

sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_1 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_1*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_1_observed
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_2 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_2*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_2_observed
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_3 <- sess4_3afc_pred$price_3*sess4_3afc_pred$prob_3_observed
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true <- sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_1 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_2 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_3

sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_1 <- abs(sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_1 - sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_1)
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_2 <- abs(sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_2 - sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_2)
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_3 <- abs(sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_3 - sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_logit_3)
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit <- sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_1 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_2 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit_3

sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_1 <- abs(sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_1 - sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_1)
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_2 <- abs(sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_2 - sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_2)
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_3 <- abs(sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true_3 - sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_ddm_3)
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm <- sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_1 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_2 + sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm_3

sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif <- sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_logit - sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_ddm
sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif_perc <- 100*(sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_dif/sess4_3afc_pred$revenue_true)

summary_3afc_rev_pred <- sess4_3afc_pred %>% 
  group_by(discount) %>% summarize(mean_rev_perc_dif = mean(revenue_dif_perc),
                                   sd_error = sd(revenue_dif_perc),
                                   n_error = n(),
                                   SE_error = sd(revenue_dif_perc) / sqrt(n()))

summary_3afc_rev_pred$discount <- fct_relevel(summary_3afc_rev_pred$discount,
                                                       "No Discount","25 Discount","99 Discount")

p_forecasting_revenue_3afc <- ggplot(summary_3afc_rev_pred, aes(discount, mean_rev_perc_dif)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = discount, color = discount),show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount"),values=c('black',color_discount_25,color_discount_99)) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount"),values=c(color_discount_0,color_discount_25,color_discount_99)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_rev_perc_dif - SE_error, ymax = mean_rev_perc_dif + SE_error), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("No Discount","$0.25 Discount","$0.99 Discount")) +
  labs(x = "Discount", y = "Average Percentage Improvement for DDM", title = "Revenue in Ternary Choice") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
                          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
p_forecasting_revenue_3afc
save_name_png <- str_c(date_var, "_forecasting_revenue_3afc.png")
ggsave(save_name_png,plot = p_forecasting_revenue_3afc,device="png")
```

## Combined / Merged Regressions

```{r,comment=NA, echo = TRUE}
share_2afc['task'] = 'Binary Choice'
share_2afc$discount_factor <- "00"
share_2afc[(share_2afc$discount1 == 99 | share_2afc$discount2 == 99),"discount_factor"] <- "99"
share_2afc[(share_2afc$discount1 == 25 | share_2afc$discount2 == 25),"discount_factor"] <- "25"
share_2afc$ddm_advantage_scale <- as.numeric(scale(share_2afc$ddm_advantage))
share_2afc_combine <- share_2afc %>% select(competitiveness,ddm_advantage,ddm_advantage_scale,task,discount_factor)

share_3afc['task'] = 'Ternary Choice'
share_3afc$discount_factor <- "00"
share_3afc[(share_3afc$discount1 == 99 | share_3afc$discount2 == 99 | share_3afc$discount3 == 99),"discount_factor"] <- "99"
share_3afc[(share_3afc$discount1 == 25 | share_3afc$discount2 == 25 | share_3afc$discount3 == 25),"discount_factor"] <- "25"
share_3afc$ddm_advantage_scale <- as.numeric(scale(share_3afc$ddm_advantage))
share_3afc_combine <- share_3afc %>% select(competitiveness,ddm_advantage,ddm_advantage_scale,task,discount_factor)

share_combine <- bind_rows(share_2afc_combine,share_3afc_combine)

#merge all three together to get same scale for regression
sess3_2afc_market$ddm_advantage <- sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_dif
sess3_2afc_market['task'] = 'Binary Choice Within'
sess3_2afc_market$ddm_advantage_scale <- as.numeric(scale(sess3_2afc_market$rmsae_dif))
sess3_2afc_combine <- sess3_2afc_market %>% select(ddm_advantage_scale,task,discount_factor)

share_combine <- share_combine %>% 
  mutate(discount_not99 = if_else(discount_factor == "99",0,1))
model_combine <- lm(ddm_advantage_scale ~ task + discount_not99, data = share_combine)
summary(model_combine)
```

```{r,comment=NA,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
  select(brand_in2_1, cannib_item2_1_true, cannib_item2_1_ddm, cannib_item2_1_logit)
cannib_item2_share <- rename(cannib_item2_share, brand = brand_in2_1)
cannib_item2_share <- rename(cannib_item2_share, cannib_true = cannib_item2_1_true)
cannib_item2_share <- rename(cannib_item2_share, cannib_ddm = cannib_item2_1_ddm)
cannib_item2_share <- rename(cannib_item2_share, cannib_logit = cannib_item2_1_logit)

cannib_combine_share <- bind_rows(cannib_item1_share,cannib_item2_share)
cannib_combine_share <- cannib_combine_share %>%
  mutate(abs_dif = abs(cannib_true - cannib_logit) - abs(cannib_true - cannib_ddm))
cannib_combine_share %>% group_by(brand) %>% summarize(ave_cannib = mean(cannib_true),
                                                      ave_ddm = mean(cannib_ddm),
                                                      ave_logit = mean(cannib_logit),
                                                      ave_dif = mean(abs_dif))

cannib_combine_share_long <- cannib_combine_share %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("cannib_ddm","cannib_logit"), 
               names_to = "model", values_to = "cannib_predict")

p_scatter_cannib <- ggplot(data = cannib_combine_share_long, 
       mapping = aes(x = cannib_true, y = cannib_predict, color = model)) + 
       geom_point(mapping = aes(shape = model,size = 2)) +
       geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") + 
       scale_shape_manual(labels = c("DDM","Logit"), values=c(16, 5))+
       scale_color_manual(labels = c("DDM","Logit"), values = c(color_ddm,color_logit)) +
       labs(x = "Observed Cannibalization", y = "Cannibalization Change", 
            color = "Model",shape = "Model", title = "Change from an Existing Brand Entrant") +
       guides(size = FALSE) +  
       theme_minimal()  + theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
                                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                                legend.position = c(1,0),
                                legend.justification = c(1,0)) + 
       facet_wrap(~brand,ncol = 2)
p_scatter_cannib
save_name_png <- str_c(date_var, "_cannib_brand_existing_scatter_3afc_1.png")
ggsave(save_name_png,plot = p_scatter_cannib,device="png")

p_scatter_cannib <- ggplot(data = cannib_combine_share_long, 
       mapping = aes(x = cannib_true, y = cannib_predict, color = model)) +
```
